commit_message: Complete ADR0155 managed Local AI integration and measured-default gating
pr_title: GameEngine: ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation v4
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0155 managed llama.cpp integration on latest main, including provider-independent backend/runtime lifecycle, AI Studio setup, Windows/WSL identities, GGUF registration, resource arbitration, benchmark provenance, Visual fixture, migration preservation, Windows SHA-256 verification, and deterministic Windows/WSL failure-boundary tests.

Until representative WindowsNative versus Wsl2Linux characterization is measured, existing external local compatibility remains the ordinary default and Managed Local AI is an explicit engineering/advanced path rather than an unmeasured product-selected default.
